risks.name: SDK environment mismatch
risks.description: Booster SDK may require specific Python version, OS packages, or environment variables not available in all contexts
risks.mitigation: Subprocess sidecar with --sdk-python and --sdk-env-setup; lazy SDK loading
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-001 import boundary test; HW-001 connection preflight

risks.name: FastDDS configuration
risks.description: Booster ROS2 interface uses FastDDS; configuration may conflict or be missing
risks.mitigation: ROS2 discovery documented in M19R-C; use existing setup.bash sourcing pattern
risks.test_evidence_required: HW-001 connection preflight; HW-005 telemetry capture

risks.name: K1 mode lifecycle uncertainty
risks.description: SDK RobotMode enum values and valid transitions not fully documented; kPrepare/kWalking sequence may have undocumented requirements
risks.mitigation: Replicate exact legacy sequence; add generous timeouts; hardware-gated lifecycle test

risks.name: Command frame ambiguity
risks.description: Move(vx, vy, w) coordinate frame not explicitly documented; assumed body frame
risks.mitigation: Use body frame as default; expose CoordinateFrame in adapter config
risks.test_evidence_required: HW-003 bounded velocity command; verify motion direction matches command

risks.name: Odometry frame ambiguity
risks.description: Odometer x/y/theta frame relative to start pose or global frame unclear
risks.mitigation: Use relative frame assumption (dx from trial start); document assumption
risks.test_evidence_required: HW-005 telemetry capture; compare odometer motion against expected direction

risks.name: Yaw drift variability
risks.description: Yaw drift magnitude may vary with surface, speed, battery; 0.0 deg mean in M23-C may not generalize
risks.mitigation: Capture yaw in telemetry; flag anomalous drift; do not assume zero
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-007 telemetry normalization; HW-005 telemetry capture

risks.name: Speed deadband
risks.description: 0.20 m/s low-speed deadzone observed; commands near deadband may produce no motion
risks.mitigation: Document deadband; enforce minimum command velocity above deadband in preflight
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-003 safety config parsing; HW-003 bounded velocity command

risks.name: Profile/environment mismatch
risks.description: Gold profile (M19C) collected on specific surface/conditions; may not match current environment
risks.mitigation: M24 profile refresh workflow; S2 marble floor as reference surface
risks.test_evidence_required: Profile comparison tests in M24 analysis scripts

risks.name: Battery/state missing data
risks.description: No battery level or robot state data in telemetry stream; cannot detect low-battery degraded performance
risks.mitigation: Add battery/state to telemetry requirements for M27-C; operator checklist includes battery check
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-007 telemetry normalization (verify battery field handled as missing)

risks.name: Operator confirmation bypass risk
risks.description: Operator confirmation is a YAML file; no runtime challenge-response; could be edited accidentally
risks.mitigation: Hash safety config into audit trail; preflight validates hash; OperatorAuthorization with expiry
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-012 operator auth expiry; NH-010 safety no-default

risks.name: Stale telemetry
risks.description: ROS2 subscriber may receive stale messages; no timestamp-based staleness detection in legacy
risks.mitigation: Add message age check in TelemetryStream; flag or discard stale samples
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-007 telemetry normalization; HW-005 telemetry capture

risks.name: Stop acknowledgement uncertainty
risks.description: Legacy stop sends Move(0,0,0) but does not verify robot actually stopped (no velocity feedback check)
risks.mitigation: Add telemetry-based stop verification; check velocity near zero after stop phase
risks.test_evidence_required: HW-004 stop acknowledgement; HW-007 emergency stop

risks.name: Import-time vendor side effects
risks.description: Booster SDK import may trigger DDS initialization, network calls, or hardware polling
risks.mitigation: Lazy import only when dry_run=False; subprocess isolation; never import at module level
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-001 import boundary; NH-011 no auto-connect

risks.name: Package dependency contamination
risks.description: Adding booster_robotics_sdk_python as dependency would make calibration-skill uninstallable without robot SDK
risks.mitigation: SDK as optional extra [booster_k1]; never in core dependencies; enforced by pyproject.toml validation

risks.name: Windows vs Ubuntu divergence
risks.description: Core development on Windows (no SDK, no ROS2); robot runs Ubuntu (SDK + ROS2); subprocess, paths, and env differ
risks.mitigation: Subprocess sidecar handles both; dry-run tests pass on both; hardware tests Ubuntu-only
risks.test_evidence_required: NH-001 through NH-012 on Windows; HW-001 through HW-008 on Ubuntu
